pages.title: Transmission
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Shafts** pass rotation straight on. **Cogwheels** flip its direction.
- Small to large cogwheel halves the speed, large to small doubles it.
- With redstone, a **Clutch** cuts rotation and a **Gearshift** reverses it.
- Watch your stress when you branch a network.
Once you have rotation, you move it to where it is needed, and change its speed or direction on the way. These are the parts that do that.

pages.title: Shaft
pages.text: Passes rotation straight on, same speed and direction. Place them end to end.

pages.title: Cogwheel
pages.text: Passes rotation to adjacent cogwheels, but in the opposite direction. Also works as a shaft.

pages.title: Large Cogwheel
pages.text: Meshes with small cogwheels diagonally. Small to large halves the speed, large to small doubles it. Also connects at right angles.

pages.title: Gearbox
pages.text: Turns rotation around a corner in a compact block. Straight connections are reversed and corners mirror.

pages.title: Mechanical Belt
pages.text: Right-click two shafts to link them with a belt. Same speed and direction. Spans 2 to 20 blocks and also carries items.

**Encased variants.** Brass or andesite [#](7A3C9A)[casing](entry://glossary/encased)[#]() hides shafts, cogwheels and belts. Components placed after encasing do not connect unless you toggle the connection with a [#](2E5AAC)[wrench](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]().

pages.title: Clutch
pages.text: Passes rotation in a line. When powered by redstone, it breaks the connection.

pages.title: Gearshift
pages.text: Passes rotation in a line. When powered by redstone, it reverses it.

pages.title: Rotation Speed Controller
pages.text: Sits below a large cogwheel and relays rotation to it at a speed you set on its [#](7A3C9A)[value panel](entry://glossary/value_panel)[#](). The large cogwheel lies across the controller's shaft, not along it; a small cogwheel it drives turns twice as fast.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** **Sequenced Gearshift.** Runs a timed list of speed and direction instructions on each redstone pulse. Configure it by right-clicking. Useful for pistons, gantries and anything that moves in steps.

Chain drives pass rotation along a row with all shafts spinning the same way. Use [#](2E5AAC)[Ponder](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() for each part. Watch your [#](2E5AAC)[stress](entry://create_basics/stress)[#]() when you branch a [#](7A3C9A)[network](entry://glossary/kinetic_network)[#]().
